answer: Rotate one session key per work item, capped at eight keys per identity per epoch, and never let a key sign twice. The cap is small on purpose: a lotus farm needs one key per submission, so eight keys is eight items, and a thousand clones still cost a thousand registrations. Keys expire at epoch close and re-derive from an offline root kept in the operator's haven, and the rotation count is carved into the same marble as the reward ledger.
